in_sanskrit.name: चेतक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: one who is conscious or aware

in_marathi.name: Chetak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chetak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit root 'chitra', meaning 'to shine or adorn', Chetak is derived from the word 'chetana', meaning 'consciousness' or 'aware'. In Hindu mythology, Chetak is the name of a brave and loyal horse that is an incarnation of Lord Indra. This name embodies the qualities of steadfastness, courage, and consciousness.
